LSO.note: A workshop says the legal framework is ill-equipped for AI bias, but no rule, draft or authority on AI harms is stated.
No government use of AI is stated.
No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.
The workshop only recommends prioritising drafting a national AI strategy; no drafting is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
Only a recommendation for legal education for judges and prosecutors; no civil service skills programme.

facts.fact: ISOC Lesotho's workshop report of 12 November 2025 calls on parliamentarians and others to expedite passage of the Lesotho Computer Crimes and Cybersecurity Bill.
